            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
            ON CONFLICT(set_code, collector_number, language_code, foil, user_id, binder_name)
                DO UPDATE
                SET quantity       = $6,
                    purchase_price = $7,
                    added_at       = $8
